entities.summary: Bełżyce is a town in eastern Poland, in the Lublin Voivodeship, in Lublin County, and about 20 km (12 mi) to the west of the city of Lublin. Bełżyce belongs to the historical region of Lesser Poland. As of December 2021, the town has a population of 6,290.
